payload.title: A Visit to William Blake's Inn
payload.paragraph_text: A Visit to William Blake's Inn: Poems for Innocent and Experienced Travelers is a children's picture book written by Nancy Willard and illustrated by Alice and Martin Provensen, published by Harcourt Brace in 1981. The next year Willard won the annual Newbery Medal and the Provensens were one runner-up for the Caldecott Medal from the professional children's librarians. "William Blake's Inn" was the first Newbery-winning book to also be named a Caldecott Honor Book. "Last Stop on Market Street" later won the 2016 Newbery Medal and a Caldecott Honor.
